about: The inputs the qptiff profile rejects, each with the start of its message (the Rust tests' prefix, or what each store test's message contains), and, where the Python host rejects it earlier, the host's message. rust/refkv-ir/build.rs writes a Rust test per case into tests/qptiff.rs; python/tests/ir/test_rejects.py checks each through the host and that every rejected fixture is listed here.

cases.message: a QPTIFF with 3 channels has 2 ReducedResolution images, not a multiple of 3
QPTIFF channels have 3 samples per pixel
IFD 0 of a QPTIFF is not a FullResolution image
IFD 0 of a QPTIFF has no PerkinElmer-QPI image description
QPTIFF level 1 is not smaller than level 0
a QPTIFF FullResolution image follows the baseline images
the images of QPTIFF level 1 differ in size, tiling or format
IFD at 8 has 3 tiles or strips, expected 5
